reason: Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Match reviewed GeoNames ISO3 to World Bank economy ID. World Bank aggregates and territory categories require explicit filtering; ISO2 differs between API endpoints. Evidence gap: the full endpoint projection/crosswalk and stated cardinality/temporal constraints have not been verified. Country/territory in ISO scope is distinct from sovereignty, jurisdiction, statistical area, sales territory and locality. A place label is not a globally unique key. Country context is necessary but insufficient for same-named settlements; postcode associations can be many-to-many. Retain leading zeros and historical/category scope. Implement a versioned raw-value-to-reviewed-code bridge with ambiguity and unmatched outputs before external lookup.
